entries.title: The heartbleed bug
entries.key_innovation: Describes the Heartbleed bug in OpenSSL's TLS heartbeat extension, a memory disclosure vulnerability caused by missing bounds validation.

entries.title: The equifax data breach
entries.key_innovation: Case study of the Equifax data breach, likely analyzing exploitation of Apache Struts vulnerability and patch management failures.

entries.title: Automated vulnerability detection in source code using deep representation learning
entries.key_innovation: Uses deep representation learning to automatically detect vulnerabilities in source code.

entries.title: A systematic literature review on automated software vulnerability detection using machine learning
entries.key_innovation: Provides a systematic literature review characterizing ML-based software vulnerability detection systems across six research questions, using a custom web scraper over four digital libraries.

entries.title: Codexglue
entries.key_innovation: CodeXGLUE benchmark suite for code intelligence tasks.

entries.title: Codebert
entries.key_innovation: Pre-trained bimodal model for programming and natural language, enabling code-related understanding and generation.

entries.title: Unixcoder
entries.key_innovation: UniXcoder is a unified cross-modal pre-trained programming language model using mask attention matrices with prefix adapters and a one-to-one AST-to-sequence mapping to retain tree structure.

entries.title: Chatgpt for vulnerability detection
entries.key_innovation: Empirically evaluates ChatGPT (gpt-3.5-turbo/gpt-4) on function/line-level vulnerability prediction, classification, severity estimation, and repair, finding it trails specialized models.

entries.title: Function-level vulnerability detection through fusing multi-modal knowledge
entries.key_innovation: MVulD fuses text, graph, and image representations of functions for vulnerability detection, exploiting underutilized image modality and graph structure.

entries.title: How does pre-trained language model perform on deep learning framework bug prediction?
entries.key_innovation: KnowBug enhances pre-trained language models with bug report knowledge and prompt-based fine-tuning to predict bugs in deep learning frameworks.

entries.title: Qemu third party repository commit 98f3433
entries.key_innovation: Specific QEMU third-party repository commit 98f3433; likely a patch or code change with no stated methodological innovation.

entries.title: Large language models for test-free fault localization
entries.key_innovation: LLMAO fine-tunes bidirectional adapter layers on top of LLM representations to perform line-level fault localization without requiring test inputs.

entries.title: Improving fault localization and program repair with deep semantic features and transferred knowledge
entries.key_innovation: TRANSFER leverages deep semantic features and transferred knowledge from open-source projects to improve both fault localization and automated program repair.

entries.title: Ac/c++ code vulnerability dataset with code changes and cve summaries
entries.key_innovation: Big-Vul dataset links 3,754 C/C++ vulnerabilities from 348 GitHub projects with CVE metadata and vulnerability-related code changes.

entries.title: Backup code and checkpoints for Localizer and Detector from paper
entries.key_innovation: Provides backup code and checkpoints for Localizer and Detector models; no new method described.

entries.title: Empirical analysis of ck metrics for object-oriented design complexity
entries.key_innovation: Provides empirical evidence that Chidamber-Kemerer object-oriented design complexity metrics are significantly associated with software defects after controlling for size.

entries.title: Measuring the psychological complexity of software maintenance tasks with the halstead and mccabe metrics
entries.key_innovation: Compares Halstead and McCabe complexity metrics against programmer performance on maintenance tasks, showing they predict psychological complexity primarily in unstructured, uncommented code.

entries.title: On the accuracy of spectrum-based fault localization
entries.key_innovation: Analyzes spectrum-based fault localization accuracy, showing a superior similarity coefficient is largely independent of test design and near-optimal accuracy requires only low-quality error observations.

entries.title: Metallaxis-fl
entries.key_innovation: Uses mutation analysis to link mutants killed mostly by failing tests to faulty program locations, assigning suspiciousness values for fault localization.

entries.title: Exploring machine learning techniques for fault localization
entries.key_innovation: Adapts a neural network fault localization approach to object-oriented code and explores support vector machines for context-independent debugging.

entries.title: Automated software vulnerability detection with machine learning
entries.key_innovation: Applies machine learning to automate software vulnerability detection.

entries.title: Machinelearning based vulnerability analysis of existing buildings
entries.key_innovation: Uses machine learning to analyze vulnerability of existing buildings.

entries.title: A systematic literature review of software defect prediction studies using source code semantic information
entries.key_innovation: Reviews software defect prediction studies that use source code semantic information.

entries.title: Vuldeepecker
entries.key_innovation: Represents programs as code gadgets and transforms them into vectors for deep learning-based vulnerability detection.

entries.title: Learning to represent programs with graphs
entries.key_innovation: Learns program representations using graphs.

entries.title: Unified pre-training for program understanding and generation
entries.key_innovation: Proposes unified pre-training for both program understanding and generation.

entries.title: Enhancing fault localization through ordered code analysis with llm agents and selfreflection
entries.key_innovation: Uses LLM agents with ordered code analysis and self-reflection to enhance fault localization.

entries.title: A quantitative and qualitative evaluation of llm-based explainable fault localization
entries.key_innovation: Uses an LLM with function-call repository navigation to generate bug explanations and localize faults, overcoming context length limits.

entries.title: Graph neural network for source code defect prediction
entries.key_innovation: Uses a convolutional graph neural network over abstract syntax tree nodes and edges for defect prediction, with architecture adaptable to project size.

entries.title: Semantic feature learning for software defect prediction from source code and external knowledge
entries.key_innovation: Learns semantic features from source code and external knowledge for software defect prediction.

entries.title: Line-level semantic structure learning for code vulnerability detection
entries.key_innovation: Learns line-level semantic structure for code vulnerability detection.

entries.title: No more fine-tuning? an experimental evaluation of prompt tuning in code intelligence
entries.key_innovation: Empirically evaluates prompt tuning as an alternative to fine-tuning for code intelligence tasks, inserting prompts to provide task-specific knowledge.

entries.title: Parameter-efficient multi-classification software defect detection method based on pretrained llms
entries.key_innovation: Proposes a parameter-efficient multi-classification software defect detection method based on pretrained large language models.

entries.title: Finetuning large language models for vulnerability detection
entries.key_innovation: Fine-tunes WizardCoder with modified training and class-imbalance handling for Java vulnerability detection.

entries.title: Wizardcoder
entries.key_innovation: Introduces WizardCoder, a large language model for code.

entries.title: Automatic classification method for software vulnerability based on deep neural network
entries.key_innovation: Combines TF-IDF, information gain feature selection, and a deep neural network for automatic software vulnerability classification.

entries.title: Dekedver
entries.key_innovation: Title-only; no abstract or method details available to extract a technical innovation.

entries.title: Aibughunter
entries.key_innovation: Integrates ML-based vulnerability detection, explanation, and repair into VS Code for real-time C/C++ analysis.

entries.title: Impact of large language models of code on fault localization
entries.key_innovation: Fine-tunes large language models of code for fault localization via sequence generation, removing the need for coverage matrices.

entries.title: Code-aware fault localization with pre-training and interpretable machine learning
entries.key_innovation: Title suggests a code-aware fault localization method combining pre-trained models and interpretable machine learning.

entries.title: Graphcodebert

entries.title: Decoupled weight decay regularization

entries.title: Large language models for software engineering
entries.key_innovation: Conducts a systematic literature review of 395 LLM4SE papers, categorizing models, methods, datasets, and limitations.

entries.title: On the effectiveness of function-level vulnerability detectors for inter-procedural vulnerabilities
entries.key_innovation: Creates InterPVD dataset and VulTrigger tool to identify cross-function vulnerability-triggering statements, revealing function-level detector limitations.

entries.title: Machine-learning based vulnerability analysis of existing buildings
entries.key_innovation: Title suggests machine-learning-based vulnerability assessment for existing buildings; no method details available.

entries.key_innovation: Introduces MSDD-(IA)3, injecting (IA)3 vectors into CodeT5+ for parameter-efficient multi-class software defect detection.
